title: Paloma Business Billing Terms: The Subscription Charge of a Billing Period
content:
**Charge clause.** The subscription charge of a billing period of a monthly-billed Paloma Business account is the plan's monthly fee, booked in full as that period's subscription fee and rounded half up to the cent. The charge is never below 0.00 and is booked as one subscription fee entry for that billing period.

**Annual billing.** An annually billed Paloma Business account is charged the plan's annual fee at the start of every twelfth period, unchanged, rounded half up to the cent.

### The charge restated

| Billing cycle | Amount of the subscription charge | When it is charged |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly | The plan's monthly fee, in full | Every billing period |
| Annual | The plan's annual fee, unchanged | The start of every twelfth period |

### Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

1. A monthly-billed Paloma Business Growth account: the plan's monthly fee is 49.00 USD, booked in full, so the subscription charge of the period is 49.00 USD.
2. A monthly-billed Paloma Business Scale account: the subscription charge is the monthly fee of 299.00 USD.
3. An annually billed Paloma Business Pro account: at the start of every twelfth period the charge is the annual fee of 1290.00 USD; the annual fee is not changed in any way.

### Basis Q&A

**Is the subscription charge of a period booked as one entry or several?** One subscription fee entry for that billing period.

**Can the charge be a negative amount?** No. It is never below 0.00.
